description: A blocky tree spirit from the front: a cloud-like leafy crown with bumpy lobes, a square trunk body with two eyes and a zigzag mouth, stubby branch arms at the sides and two short legs.
A straight broadsword on a diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, with a long blade ending in an angled notched tip, a wide rectangular crossguard with an inner slot, and a short grip.

A stick figure leaning on a diagonal: a round head at the upper right, a straight body line running to the lower left, a straight arm crossing it at right angles, and one bent leg hooking downward; hard to read.
A small robot from the front: two round binocular eye lenses joined across the top, a thin neck, a boxy body with a front panel, and wide tank treads flaring out on both sides at the bottom.
A hanging banner with a V-notched swallowtail bottom, suspended from a horizontal pole with a round finial at the left, beside a tall vertical staff at the right.
A curved horn lying horizontally: a narrow tip curling up at the left, widening along a sweeping curve to a flared open bell mouth at the upper right.
A curved scimitar on a diagonal: a long blade arcing up to a pointed tip at the upper right, a short straight crossguard, and a grip at the lower left.
A front-facing lion head with a shield-shaped mane, a broad nose and muzzle, and two feathered wings rising up and outward from the sides of the head.
A winged lion walking in profile facing right: a large curly mane around its head, a feathered wing raised from its back toward the upper left, four legs and a tail curling behind.
